topic: Renting a PO Box for Mail While Between Homes

script.title: A MAILBOX TO CALL HOME
script.story_hook: No home address yet, but the mail must land.
script.intro_zh: 暫時沒有住址，但郵件一定要收得到。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to the post office counter. Today we rent a mailbox between homes.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到郵局櫃台。今天的主題是搬家空檔怎麼租信箱。
script.outro: And that's a mailbox, a card, and a plan. New towns get easier line by line.
script.outro_zh: 一個信箱、一張卡、一個安排都就緒了。新的城市會一句一句變得輕鬆。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: so my address is now this box
script.char_a_description: a middle-aged man in his forties with cropped dark hair, a short trimmed beard, a rust orange flannel shirt under a brown canvas work jacket, and a broad sturdy build
script.char_b_description: a friendly woman in her fifties with dark brown hair in a tight low bun, gold-rimmed glasses, a blue postal polo shirt with a name tag, and a plump brisk build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I just moved here, need a mailing address.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ dʒʌst muːvd hɪɹ nid ə ˈmeɪ.lɪŋ əˈdɹɛs/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我剛搬來這裡，需要一個收信地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're in the right line, boxes or forms?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹz ɪn ðə raɪt laɪn ˈbɑk.səz ɔɹ fɔɹmz/
dialogue.zh: 你排對隊了，要租信箱還是填表格？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A box, my old address stopped existing, um, basically.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bɑks maɪ oʊld əˈdɹɛs stɑpt ɪɡˈzɪs.tɪŋ ʌm ˈbeɪ.sɪ.kli/
dialogue.zh: 租信箱，我舊的地址基本上已經作廢了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, between houses? It happens a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt bɪˈtwin ˈhaʊ.zəz ɪt hə.pənz ə lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 了解，舊家賣了、新家還沒到位是吧？這種情況很常見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly. Sold mine, new place opens in November.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæk.li soʊld maɪn nju pleɪs ˈoʊ.pənz ɪn noʊˈvɛm.bɚ/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，舊屋賣了，新家十一月才入住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So a six-month rental could cover the gap.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ə sɪks mʌnθ ˈrɛn.təl kʊd ˈkʌv.ɚ ðə ɡæp/
dialogue.zh: 那租六個月的信箱，剛好接上這段空檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six months is an option? What sizes do you have?
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈmʌn.θɪz ɪz æn ˈɑp.ʃən wʌt ˈsaɪ.zəz du ju hæv/
dialogue.zh: 六個月也可以選嗎？你們有幾種尺寸？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small, medium, large, and the quirky corner ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl ˈmi.di.əm lɑɹdʒ ænd ðə ˈkwɪr.ki ˈkɔɹ.nɚ wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 小、中、大，還有一些角落裡的不規則尺寸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Corner ones? What's quirky about them?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔɹ.nɚ wʌnz wʌts ˈkwɪr.ki əˈbaʊt ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 角落的？那些有什麼特別的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Odd shapes, but fine for regular mail.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑd ʃeɪps bʌt faɪn fɚ ˈrɛɡ.jə.lɚ meɪl/
dialogue.zh: 形狀比較怪，不過收一般信件完全沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Medium, please, I get big envelopes too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmi.di.əm pliz aɪ ɡɛt bɪɡ ˈɛn.ə.loʊpz tu/
dialogue.zh: 請給我中號的，我也會收到大信封。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. Medium is fourteen fifty a month.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt ˈmi.di.əm ɪz ˌfɔɹˈtin ˈfɪf.ti ə mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。中號一個月十四塊五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, how much is the small one?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ˈhaʊ ˈmʌtʃ ɪz ðə ˈsmɔl ˈwʌn/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那小號多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten ninety-nine, but it fills up fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈnɪn.ti naɪn bʌt ɪt fɪlz ʌp fæst/
dialogue.zh: 十塊九毛九，不過一下就會塞滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then medium, no contest there honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈmi.di.əm noʊ kənˈtɛst ðɛr ˈɑ.nəst.li/
dialogue.zh: 那就中號吧，這真的不用猶豫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good pick. Six months comes to eighty-seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd pɪk sɪks ˈmʌn.θɪz kʌmz tu ˈeɪ.ti ˈsɛv.ən/
dialogue.zh: 選得好。六個月的話是八十七塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a year cheaper per month though?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ə jɪɹ ˈtʃi.pɚ pɚ mʌnθ ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那租一年每月會不會便宜一些？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, twelve months drops it to thirteen twenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs twɛlv mʌn.θɪz drɑps ɪt tə ˌθɝˈtin ˈtwɛn.ti/
dialogue.zh: 會，租一年可以降到十三塊二。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tough call, but I like staying free to move.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʌf kɔl bʌt aɪ laɪk ˈsteɪ.ɪŋ fri tə muːv/
dialogue.zh: 難選，但我喜歡來去自由。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair, six months it is. Name, please?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr sɪks ˈmʌn.θɪz ɪt ɪz neɪm pliz/
dialogue.zh: 也對，那就六個月。請問大名？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's Marcus Webb, W-E-B-B.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈmɑɹ.kəs wɛb ˈdʌb.əl.ju i bi bi/
dialogue.zh: 馬克斯．衛伯，衛是 W-E-B-B。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you, Marcus. Any ID with you?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs tə miːt ju ˈmɑɹ.kəs ˈɛ.ni aɪˈdi wɪð ju/
dialogue.zh: 很高興認識你，馬克斯。隨身帶身份證明嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, driver's license, here you go.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈdɹaɪ.vɚz ˈlaɪ.səns hɪɹ ju ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 有，駕照，給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, and a phone number for notices?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝ.fɪkt ænd ə foʊn ˈnʌm.bɚ fɚ ˈnoʊ.tɪ.sɪz/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。再留一個電話號碼收通知？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, it's my cell, I'll dictate it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ɪts maɪ sɛl aɪl ˈdɪk.teɪt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，是我的手機號碼，我唸你抄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Now this form, sign at the bottom.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt naʊ ðɪs fɔɹm saɪn æt ðə ˈbɑ.təm/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。這張表格在底端簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Oh wait, how do I actually open the box?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn oʊ weɪt haʊ du aɪ ˈæk.tʃu.ə.li ˈoʊ.pən ðə bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 簽好了。噢等等，信箱到底怎麼開？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Key card, tap it, the green light means go.
dialogue.phonetic: /ki kɑɹd ˈtæp ɪt ðə ˈɡrin ˈlaɪt ˈminz ˈɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 鑰匙卡，輕觸一下，綠燈亮就可以開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cool, is the card an extra fee?
dialogue.phonetic: /kul ɪz ðə kɑɹd ən ˈæk.strə fi/
dialogue.zh: 好酷。這張卡要另外收費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five dollars deposit, back when you return it.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈdɑ.lɚz dɪˈpɑ.zɪt bæk wɛn ju ɹiˈtɝn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 押金五塊，退卡的時候會還你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair. What if the card takes a vacation with me?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ wʌt ɪf ðə kɑɹd teɪks ə veɪˈʃən wɪð mi/
dialogue.zh: 合理。萬一卡片跟著我去度假了呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, replacement is ten, keep it close.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɹɪˈpleɪs.mənt ɪz tɛn kip ɪt kloʊs/
dialogue.zh: 哈，補辦要十塊，收好它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will do. Quick question about packages.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl du kwɪk ˈkwɛs.tʃən əˈbaʊt ˈpæk.ɪ.dʒəz/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。想快問一件事，包裹怎麼收？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Boxes hold letters, packages wait up front.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɑk.səz hoʊld ˈlɛ.tɚz ˈpæk.ɪ.dʒəz weɪt ʌp frʌnt/
dialogue.zh: 信箱只放得下信件，包裹會暫放在櫃台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I get a note when a box is waiting?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ ɡɛt ə noʊt wɛn ə bɑks ɪz ˈweɪ.tɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 所以有包裹時，我會收到一張通知單？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, and you have fifteen days to grab it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæk.li ænd ju hæv ˌfɪfˈtin deɪz tə ɡɹæb ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，你有十五天時間來取件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: After fifteen days, does it sail back?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæk.fɚ ˌfɪfˈtin deɪz dʌz ɪt seɪl bæk/
dialogue.zh: 過了十五天，包裹會自己回到寄件人那裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, return to sender, nice and tidy.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ɹɪˈtɝn tə ˈsɛn.dɚ naɪs ænd ˈtaɪ.di/
dialogue.zh: 對，退回原地，乾乾淨淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. One worry, is my box ready today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝ.fɪkt wʌn ˈwɝ.i ɪz maɪ bɑks ˈrɛ.di təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我還擔心一件事：信箱今天就緒了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check the board... medium, number twelve.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk ðə bɔɹd ˈmi.di.əm ˈnʌm.bɚ twɛlv/
dialogue.zh: 我看一下看板……中號，十二號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve, nice. When can I start using it?
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv naɪs wɛn kən aɪ stɑɹt ˈju.zɪŋ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 十二號，不錯。我什麼時候開始能用？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right now, the card activates in one minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt naʊ ðə kɑɹd ˈæk.təˌveɪts ɪn wʌn ˈmɪ.nət/
dialogue.zh: 現在就能用，卡片一分鐘後生效。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, so my address is now this box.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ soʊ maɪ əˈdɹɛs ɪz naʊ ðɪs bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 哇，所以我現在的地址就是這個箱子了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, welcome to mailbox country, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈwɛl.kəm tə ˈmeɪl.bæks ˈkʌn.tri hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，歡迎來到信箱王國，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha. Can I give this address to my boss?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ kæn aɪ ɡɪv ðɪs əˈdɹɛs tə maɪ bɔs/
dialogue.zh: 哈。我可以把這個地址報給公司嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, copy it from this little white card.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈkɑ.pi ɪt fɹʌm ðɪs ˈlɪ.ɾəl waɪt kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 可以，照著這張小白卡抄就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, the exact format is already on here?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ði ɪɡˈzækt ˈfɔɹ.mæt ɪz ɔlˈrɛ.di ɑn hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，正確的寫法已經印在上面了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mm-hm, take two, they're free, don't be shy.
dialogue.phonetic: /əm ˈhəm teɪk tu ðeɪz fri doʊnt bi ʃaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯哼，影本免費，多拿兩張，別客氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Taking three, my printer hates me lately.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈteɪk.ɪŋ θri maɪ ˈprɪn.tɚ heɪts mi ˈleɪt.li/
dialogue.zh: 那我拿三張，印表機最近老跟我作對。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, fair. Today it's ninety-two with deposit.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ fɛr təˈdeɪ ɪts ˈnɪn.ti tu wɪð dɪˈpɑ.zɪt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，合理。今天連押金總共九十二塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An even total, I love round numbers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ən ˈiː.vən ˈtoʊ.təl aɪ lʌv raʊnd ˈnʌm.bɚz/
dialogue.zh: 總數剛好是整數，我喜歡這樣的數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Card or cash today?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑɹd ɔɹ kæʃ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今天刷卡還是付現金？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card, tap, um, did it print the receipt?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑɹd tæp ʌm dɪd ɪt prɪnt ðə ɹɪˈsit/
dialogue.zh: 刷卡，嗯，收據有印出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It did, keep it with your new card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dɪd ˈkip ɪt wɪð jɔɹ ˈnju kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 有，請把收據和新卡收在一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks. Honestly, this whole thing felt scary.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks ˈɑ.nəst.li ðɪs hoʊl θɪŋ fɛlt ˈskɛɹ.i/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。老實講，我來之前心裡很慌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New town? The mail is easier than it looks.
dialogue.phonetic: /nju taʊn ðə meɪl ɪz ˈiː.zi.ɚ ðæn ɪt lʊks/
dialogue.zh: 換到新城市了吧？收信其實比想像簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yeah, first solo move at my age, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /je fɝst ˈsoʊ.loʊ muːv æt maɪ eɪdʒ hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，到我這把年紀還第一次獨自搬家，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Respect. Boxes, forms, feelings, all handled.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹɪˈspɛkt ˈbɑk.səz fɔɹmz ˈfil.ɪŋz ɔl ˈhæn.dəld/
dialogue.zh: 厲害。信箱、表格、還有心情，通通搞定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're kind. See you at box twelve.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹz ˈkaɪnd ˈsi ju æt ˈbɑks ˈtwɛlv/
dialogue.zh: 你人真好。十二號信箱見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye Marcus, may the letters keep coming.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ˈmɑɹ.kəs meɪ ðə ˈlɛ.tɚz kip ˈkʌm.ɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 再見馬克斯，願你的信件源源不絕。

script.youtube_title_en: "So My Address Is Now This Box" — Renting a PO Box Between Homes
script.youtube_description:
「所以我現在的地址就是這個箱子了」——舊家賣了、新家還沒交屋，這段沒有住址的空檔，信要往哪收？這一集用 60 句連續對話，帶你在一間郵局裡把信箱租好、卡辦好、包裹規則聽懂。

你會聽到：說明自己正搬家在兩個家之間；大小尺寸與月租差價；六個月對一年合約怎麼比較；填表、證件、電話通知的順序；門禁卡押金與補辦費用；包裹不放信箱而是櫃台暫存、十五天取件規則；還有怎麼把新地址報給公司與朋友。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與十分鐘內聽得懂的短句，重現在郵局櫃檯最真實的美式語感：um、oh、so、ha、yeah。聽完你就會用：What sizes do you have?、Five dollars deposit、Return to sender、Card or cash?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"So my address is now this box" — sold the old house, waiting on the new one, and meanwhile the mail has to go somewhere. This 60-line immersive listening practice covers renting a PO box from the size question to the very first delivery.

You will hear: explaining a between-homes move, comparing box sizes and rental lengths, the ID and form routine, key card deposits, the package shelf and its fifteen-day rule, and how to hand out your temporary address.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with real counter small talk: um, oh, so, ha, yeah. By the end you'll own phrases like What sizes do you have?, Return to sender, and Card or cash?

The back half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

📌 影片簡介：
舊房子賣掉了，新家要到十一月才能住進去，可銀行的信、公司的表格、線上買的包裹，全都還在路上。這段沒有住址的日子，該怎麼辦？

這一集帶大家走進郵局大廳，從說明來意、比較信箱尺寸與合約月份，一路聽到門禁卡押金、包裹暫存規則、與怎麼把新地址報給所有人，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
📮 說明來意：Hi, I just moved here, need a mailing address.
🗂️ 選尺寸：Six months is an option? What sizes do you have?
🔑 門禁卡：Key card, tap it, the green light means go.
📦 包裹規則：Boxes hold letters, packages wait up front.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、so、yeah 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著辦完這趟信箱，下次你搬家到任何城市，都知道第一件事該去哪裡問。

祝你的每一封信都找得到你。
